tasks_completed.description: Replace 5 old call sites in _merge_day_data that used poi.get('time') with calls to new timeline lookup methods
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced 5 _normalize_time(x.get('time')) calls with _get_meal_time_from_timeline / _get_timeline_time calls that actually read from timeline.json
tasks_completed.rationale: The new methods (_get_timeline_time, _get_meal_time_from_timeline) were written to look up times from timeline.json, but the 5 call sites were never updated to use them — they still called _normalize_time(poi.get('time')) which returned None because time fields were stripped from POI files.

git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: All 5 call sites now invoke the correct timeline-based lookup methods, completing the timeline.json single-source-of-truth migration
